shock_metric.description: Explosive benchmark disparity or order-of-magnitude leap (e.g. 10x faster or $100M compute cost).

villain_first.description: Immediate identification of the mechanical bottleneck suffocating modern AI.

curiosity_trap.description: Revealing hidden mechanics behind everyday developer tools (Cursor, Claude, PyTorch).
